g.text: Candidate KKT against all five MST comparators
Solid points: median of all 12 paired KKT/comparator ratios. Below 1 favors KKT. Dashed: parity; dotted: 0.90.
All cases and observations retained. Ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Lines connect tested sizes only; no interpolated crossover is claimed.
0 flagged calls remain included. Each algorithm occupies every timed position once per child.
